papers.title: Say the Same, Act Differently: Diagnosing and Steering Text-Action Divergence in Reasoning VLAs
papers.problem: Safety monitors read a robot's written reasoning, but an attacker can change the action and leave that text untouched.
papers.fix: Tiny image changes caused new crashes in 52.6% of driving scenes while the written reasoning stayed word-for-word identical.
papers.practicalUseCase: Matching reasoning text does not prove a safe action, so check the action output directly.
papers.limitation: Tests covered two models, one for driving and one for manipulation.

papers.title: FinForesight: A Diagnostic Backtesting Benchmark for Deep Research Systems in Financial Forecasting
papers.problem: Tests of AI forecasters can reward memorized outcomes or evidence that appeared after the forecast date.
papers.fix: Old-period scores beat post-cutoff scores in most comparisons, and strict evidence limits narrowed the gap to live results.
papers.practicalUseCase: Old backtest scores overstate real forecasting skill, so block post-date evidence and trust live results more.
papers.limitation: Controlled backtests only approximate future performance; they do not replace live testing.

papers.title: When Fine-Grained Credit Assignment Helps and Hurts: Multimodal Agentic Reinforcement Learning through Video Editing
papers.problem: Training AI agents on long editing tasks gives delayed feedback, and it was unclear when step-by-step rewards help.
papers.fix: Fading step rewards gave a 45.4% gain on tasks over 60 turns, but at most 10.4% on short ones.
papers.practicalUseCase: Use fading step rewards only for long tasks, because fixed rewards make agents game the score.
papers.limitation: Results come from movie-trailer editing tasks, so other domains may differ.

papers.title: SphereFlow: Missing Modality Imputation via Geometric Transport on Hypersphere
papers.problem: When a medical scan type is missing, generators must make a long, unstructured jump between scan types.
papers.fix: Placing all scan types on one sphere gave top image quality and closed about 80% of the tumor-detection gap.
papers.practicalUseCase: Missing scans can be filled well enough to train tumor detectors almost as well as full data.
papers.limitation: Tests used brain MRI and CT-MRI data only.

papers.title: The influence of transformational leadership on job satisfaction and employee performance: a moderated mediation analysis of intrinsic motivation and perceived calling in Sierra Leone
papers.problem: Public-sector managers in Sierra Leone lacked evidence on how leadership style affects staff satisfaction and performance.
papers.fix: Inspiring leadership raised satisfaction and performance by boosting inner motivation, most for staff with a strong sense of calling.
papers.practicalUseCase: If you lead a team, link tasks to purpose, because that costs little and lifts motivation.
papers.limitation: Single-time survey data shows links, not cause, and comes from one country.

papers.title: Are students dependent on AI in writing courses? Analyzing factors influencing dependence on generative AI through the I-PACE model
papers.problem: Students use AI to write more, but little was known about why some come to depend on it.
papers.fix: Academic stress, AI skill, and trust in AI all shaped how much students depended on AI for writing.
papers.practicalUseCase: Stress pushes people toward leaning on AI, so manage deadlines and check AI output yourself.
papers.limitation: Survey data from college students shows links, not cause.
